what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted to recommend several special town meeting articles, including the FY21 budget adjustment, the OPEB trust fund (6-1) and the salary administration plan.
The committee deferred its recommendation on the capital plan, article 2, to town meeting.
A motion to recommend the special purpose stabilization deposit, article 5, failed, and the committee then voted to defer it to town meeting.
The committee deferred the TIF (article 15), streetlights (article 19) and articles 7, 8, 13, 14 and 20, pending figures or other committees' review.
The committee voted to skip the meeting on the 22nd and meet on the 29th, and to ask the LED presenter to attend.

why_it_matters: Several of these articles would move town money into capital, stabilization and retirement-benefit funds, and the votes at special town meeting will be the ones that commit it.
The TIF, capital plan and streetlight conversion were left without a committee recommendation, so residents will see them at town meeting without that guidance and with figures still awaited.
watch_next: The committee's next meeting on the 29th, with the LED streetlight presenter invited and updated figures awaited.
Members were asked to think about a TIF policy recommendation before special town meeting.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on most article votes: Articles 1, 2, 3, 9, 10, 11, 12, 15, 16, 17/18 and 19, the deferral of 7, 8, 13, 14 and 20, and the 10/29 meeting. They differ on Article 5, which only our minutes record, and on the Article 6 OPEB vote, which the official minutes print without an article number. A reader should check the recording and the official minutes on Article 5 first, because our failed recommendation and later deferral have no counterpart in the official text.
